paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about sorting household waste. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.label: Đề xuất đầu
paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a neighbourhood recycling workshop. This would give you an opportunity to practise sorting common household items. One potential benefit is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers.

Thank you for your time and consideration. Please let me know if you require any further information. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
